units.source_text: 一有机会就窥视老师的脸色，已成为我的一种可怜的习惯，

en.t: Watching the teacher's expression whenever I had the chance had already become a pathetic habit of mine,

units.source_text: 但在这习惯中没有浮现出任何特别的感情来。

en.t: but no particular feeling ever surfaced within that habit.

units.source_text: 这种无表情也算不上是什么冰冷。

en.t: This lack of expression could not really be called coldness either.

units.source_text: 即使这意味着污辱，可也不是冲着我个人，

en.t: Even if it amounted to an insult, it was not directed at me personally,

units.source_text: 而是冲着更普遍的东西，譬如冲着一般人性或种种抽象概念而来的。

en.t: but at something more universal, such as human nature in general or various abstract concepts.
